statements.t: While the Company continues to review and compile refund requests and may record additional refund amounts in the future, the amount is not anticipated to have a material impact to our financial position and results of operations.
At this time, we do not expect the potential direct impact to be material to our operating results.

The organic revenue decline was primarily driven by lower project volumes within our communication technologies business.

The organic revenue growth was primarily driven by higher project volumes within our aids to navigation and transportation businesses, partially offset by lower project volumes within our communication technologies business.
Project volumes, primarily within our communication technologies, aids to navigation, and transportation systems businesses, can vary from period to period based on the timing of project execution.
